name: Mercenary Sidestep
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Sidestep (players/thief/mercenary/sidestep_merc.sval, 16 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 5 (in brackets): evasion 15% (25%); recharge 5 s (3 s). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: 15% evasion, and a guaranteed dodge that recharges over 5 s.
